description: Source code for the host_resolver component in Chromium, implementing DNS resolution, host management, and related utilities.

classes.name: HostResolver::Host
classes.description: Represents a host which can be a URL scheme host port or a host-port pair, providing methods to access its components.

classes.name: HostResolver::HttpsSvcbOptions
classes.description: Holds options for DNS HTTPS Service Binding (SVCB) configurations, including feature flags and timing parameters.

classes.name: HostResolver::ManagerOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the host resolver manager, including DNS settings.

classes.name: HostResolver::ResolveHostParameters
classes.description: Parameters for resolving a host, such as including canonical name, loopback only, etc.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::HasScheme
methods.description: Checks if the host has a URL scheme.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme of the host if available.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetHostname
methods.description: Returns the hostname component of the host.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetHostnameWithoutBrackets
methods.description: Returns the hostname without brackets if it is an IPv6 literal.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::GetPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the host.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::ToString
methods.description: Serializes the host to a string.

methods.name: HostResolver::Host::AsSchemeHostPort
methods.description: Returns the host as a SchemeHostPort object.

methods.name: HostResolver::HttpsSvcbOptions::FromDict
methods.description: Creates HttpsSvcbOptions from a dictionary of settings.

methods.name: HostResolver::HttpsSvcbOptions::FromFeatures
methods.description: Creates HttpsSvcbOptions based on feature flags.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateResolver
methods.description: Creates a host resolver with a given manager and options.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateStandaloneResolver
methods.description: Creates a standalone host resolver with specified options.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateStandaloneContextResolver
methods.description: Creates a standalone context host resolver.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateStandaloneNetworkBoundResolver
methods.description: Creates a network-bound host resolver for a specific network handle.

methods.name: HostResolver::DnsQueryTypeSetToAddressFamily
methods.description: Converts a set of DNS query types to an address family.

methods.name: HostResolver::ParametersToHostResolverFlags
methods.description: Converts resolve parameters to resolver flags.

methods.name: HostResolver::SquashErrorCode
methods.description: Normalizes error codes to a standard set.

methods.name: HostResolver::AddressListToEndpointResults
methods.description: Converts an AddressList to endpoint results.

methods.name: HostResolver::EndpointResultToAddressList
methods.description: Converts endpoint results to an AddressList.

methods.name: HostResolver::GetNonProtocolEndpoints
methods.description: Extracts non-protocol endpoints from endpoint results.

methods.name: HostResolver::AllProtocolEndpointsHaveEch
methods.description: Checks if all protocol endpoints support ECH.
